verdict.rationale: Maritime documents an always-on add-on and an 'always-on micro-VM' with persistent storage for agents like Claude Code, plus persistent Linux desktops, so long-lived agent environments are a product capability. However, nothing states actual session duration limits in hours or days. The `timeLimitMinutes` parameter suggests sessions are time-capped. Missing for 10: documented maximum session duration (hours/days), explicit guarantees for uninterrupted long-running tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep a sandbox session running for hours or days for long agent tasks
